mapper.select: WITH locked_user AS ( SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}::uuid FOR UPDATE ), expired AS ( DELETE FROM pairing_codes WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM locked_user) AND expires_at < now() ), oldest AS ( SELECT id FROM pairing_codes WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at >= now() ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET 2 ), pruned AS ( DELETE FROM pairing_codes WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM oldest) ) INSERT INTO pairing_codes(user_id, code_hash, expires_at) SELECT id, #{codeHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiresAt} FROM locked_user RETURNING id::text
UPDATE pairing_codes SET consumed_at = now() WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now() RETURNING user_id::text
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pairing_codes WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at >= now() )
